objects.summary: Codex corrects architecture so existing GPT-OSS/VM worker remains scheduler/orchestrator and adds a bounded adapter, VM launcher, fencing, idempotent GitHub comments and causal readback. Local qualification passes; real dispatch/readback/unattended runtime remains unproven.

Owner freezes all economic/scientific execution until the autonomy system itself reaches qualified READY_FOR_SCIENCE. Issue #44 must use synthetic/non-economic tasks only and preserve capital/live/prospective-exposure false.

Owner narrows critical path to Phase 1 connection only: existing worker hook, durable state, authenticated Codex dispatch/readback, GPT-OSS next decision, feature-flag isolation, synthetic recovery/fencing qualification, remote durability and runtime observability.
Owner asks informational model/reasoning-level question during active mission.
Codex answers model/reasoning question without modifying project, explicitly noting exact reasoning effort is not proven from the session. This informational detour does not advance Phase 1.
Owner explicitly resumes Phase 1 and forbids treating the informational model question as mission supersession; audit must not restart and critical path remains orchestrator connection.

Codex reports one local Phase 1 implementation with opt-in ResearchCampaign hook, durable orchestration state, authenticated GitHub dispatch/readback, exact causal identities and synthetic recovery/fencing tests. Local SHA 3f7ae0f... and remote durability/runtime observability remain unproven.

A second parallel local Phase 1 implementation is reported at 79cbacd... with similar adapter/VM executable semantics and green tests. Again VM deployment, remote durability and authenticated runtime loop remain unproven.

External remote verification finds both parallel Phase 1 SHAs absent. Owner classifies REMOTE_DURABILITY=false and the parallel outputs themselves as a convergence/fencing defect, forbids a third implementation and requires complete transportable bytes/hashes/base/manifest in Issue #44.

Codex exhaustively searches object DB, refs, reflogs, fsck and workspace and cannot recover either Phase 1 candidate. It refuses prose-based reconstruction and records exact recovery input needed. No third implementation is created.
Owner resumes the transport challenge, first requiring reconciliation to any already-produced canonical package and otherwise exact recovery of one prior variant; no new implementation allowed.

Codex proves all accessible candidate bytes are unrecoverable, including two later and two earlier implementation SHAs, filesystem/session/object stores. This closes recovery and establishes that exact Phase 1 work was lost because bytes were not transported durably.

Owner changes procedure to transport-first canonical rebuild: immutable base 42affc..., remote target branch pre-created, existing runtime/orchestrator primitives verified, max-small additive patch, exact full UTF-8 file bytes + per-file hashes + manifest hash + tests + VM commands required in Issue #44 before session ends.

cross_object_findings.finding: Two nearly equivalent Phase 1 implementations were built and tested in parallel, neither persisted remotely, and both exact byte sets disappeared. This is a direct, concrete example of large effort not capitalized because convergence/persistence occurred after construction rather than before worker termination.

Detailed summaries, test counts and local commit identifiers were insufficient to reconstruct the exact implementation once Git objects/workspaces disappeared. Exact bytes or a hash-addressed patch/bundle are required for durable engineering memory.

The corrective procedure fixes immutable base and remote target before build and requires exact file contents/hashes/manifest in Issue #44 before session end. Persistence becomes a prerequisite to finishing the build, not an afterthought.

Remote base inspection proves ResearchCampaign already supports injected workers and durable runtime primitives, so the canonical rebuild should be an additive adapter/hook rather than replacement scheduler/control plane.
Economic hypothesis/outcome/prospective work is explicitly frozen during autonomy qualification, preventing infrastructure tests from contaminating science or making progress metrics ambiguous.
